description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 17.08.2015 to 23.08.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) by the Director General of Customs. It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content falls squarely under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for customs operations, specifically a statutory instrument issued under existing legislation.
